purpose: Exploratory within-film acoustic consistency audit, not biometric identity proof or calibrated error-rate evaluation
anchor_selection: Sintel 013/014 continuous injury-treatment scene with only Sintel and dragon; Shaman007 wide shot, Shaman009 close-up. Scene support and caption length selected before embedding scores. Static frames and narrative support are not audited lip-sync.
threshold_note: Exploratory conservative engineering gates selected before scores, uncalibrated to this movie and not evidence of false-accept rates. Caption duration is not measured speech duration; short lexically sparse calls remain quarantined.
